name: atelier-mission
description: Mini-CRM local pour freelance (Malt et clients directs) : prospects, devis, factures, relances. Relié à Atelier Projets (temps), Atelier Trésorerie (encaissements) et Brevo (relances).

scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate --workspace=@atelier-mission/backend && npm run db:seed --workspace=@atelier-mission/backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors auto "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.app: npm run build:frontend && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors auto "npm run dev:backend" "npm run preview --workspace=@atelier-mission/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@atelier-mission/backend && npm run build --workspace=@atelier-mission/frontend
